candidate.title: KRAUS SIEVE MODULAR METHOD EXTENSION FOR SIGNATURE (3, 3, p) ON [5201, 5300]
candidate.claim: No non-trivial primitive solutions exist for signature (3, 3, p) for all prime exponents p in [5201, 5300].
candidate.method: Modular method level lowering to conductor 72, Kraus sieve relations at auxiliary primes q = 2kp + 1 with a_q(f) = 0 mod 2.

legend.0: level 0: Settles only bounded prime exponents or dead category computation with no general leverage.
legend.1: level 1: Relevant to a single signature family or requires bounded bad reduction.
legend.2: level 2: Provides structural constraints applicable to infinite families with unbounded exponents.
legend.3: level 3: Directly attacks the general Beal conjecture for all (p, q, r) >= 3 via uniform Diophantine geometry.

candidate.title: CYCLOTOMIC NON-ABELIAN CHABAUTY-KIM OVER K = Q(zeta_m)
candidate.claim: Descent of unipotent Selmer variety Sel(U_n)(K) under Gal(K/Q) forces dim Sel(U_n)(K)^{Gal} < dim U_n(K_p)^{Gal} even for unbounded S = primes(ABC).
candidate.method: Non-abelian Chabauty-Kim, cyclotomic base change, Galois invariant Selmer varieties, Chabauty-Coleman integration.

candidate.title: RELATIVE ANABELIAN GEOMETRY OF P^1 \ {0, 1, infty} OVER SPEC Z
candidate.claim: Section conjecture and outer Galois representation into Out(pi_1^{et}(P^1 \ {0,1,infty})) isolate rational points with three-point ramification.
candidate.method: Anabelian geometry (Grothendieck, Mochizuki, Stix), étale fundamental groups, section conjecture.

candidate.title: HYPERKÄHLER PERIOD MAPS AND ARITHMETIC CHOW GROUPS OF FERMAT HYPERSURFACES
candidate.claim: The Beauville-Bogomolov quadratic form on the primitive cohomology of hyperkähler varieties associated to Fermat covers bounds integer coordinates.
candidate.method: Arithmetic Chow groups, Deligne-Beilinson cohomology, hyperkähler period domains, Arakelov heights.
